Turn JPEG photos into CMYK or single-ink halftone images on Windows.

**Install:** download the `HalftonePress-…-win-x64.zip` below, unzip the whole folder, and double-click `Halftone Press.exe`. Windows 10/11, 64-bit.

The app isn't code-signed, so on first launch Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

- CMYK color or single-ink screens
- Dot cell size, six dot shapes, dot gain, contrast, screen angles, black generation
- Batch: add many JPEGs and save them all to one folder (never overwrites)
- PNG or JPEG output, original size or scaled
- Works fully offline

The zip's SHA-256 is in the matching `.sha256` file.
